arcs.title: The Plain That Keeps Count
arcs.secret: The ridge barrows across the central plain are laid out as a stone tally of the dragon war's dead, and the final count-stone on Eldersblood Peak is one notch short.

entry.text: Chiselled into the bridge-pier at Valtheim is a mason's tally-table: four barrow-names, four numbers of dead, and a fifth line left blank beneath the words 'Count the peak last.'

quest.title: The Plain That Keeps Count
quest.desc: A mason's tally-table on the Valtheim bridge lists four barrows across the Whiterun plain and leaves the fifth line blank.
quest.desc2: The four barrow tallies converge on Eldersblood Peak, where a tally-warden still waits for the final count.
quest.pitch: A bridge-mason's mark at Valtheim says the barrows of Whiterun are a single ledger in stone.
quest.outro: At the peak I cut the missing notch into the frost-rimed slate. The barrow-fires along the ridge flared once in answer, and the plain's oldest debt was balanced.

arcs.title: The Wreck-Light Ledger
arcs.secret: False beacons along the Haafingar headlands are coordinated with an underwriter's clerk in Solitude who insures the doomed hulls twice and splits the salvage in Broken Oar Grotto.

entry.text: Wedged under the oil-cask at Solitude Lighthouse is a brass shutter-gauge stamped with four coastal bearings and an insurance clerk's cipher.

quest.title: The Wreck-Light Ledger
quest.desc: A brass shutter-gauge at Solitude Lighthouse matches the bearings of recent coastal wrecks to an underwriter's cipher.
quest.desc2: Tracing the salvaged hulls leads through Brinewater Grotto to the quartermaster's counting-room in Broken Oar Grotto.
quest.pitch: Someone has been timing the lighthouse shutters to the arrival of insured merchantmen.
quest.outro: Below the grotto's tide-line I took the double-entry salvage ledger from the quartermaster's chest. Every ship on the rocks had been sold before it ever left port.

arcs.title: The Dead Who Are Not Local
arcs.secret: A syndicate of coffin-carters has been smuggling condemned war-dead from across the southern border into Falkreath's consecrated plots for gold, hiding the unblessed rosters in Halldir's Cairn and Sunderstone Gorge.

entry.text: Behind the churchyard wall in Falkreath lies a leaden coffin-plate stamped with an Imperial quartermaster's cipher from south of the Jeralls and the note: 'Plot paid in full—ask the cairn-keeper.'

quest.title: The Dead Who Are Not Local
quest.desc: A leaden coffin-plate in Falkreath's yard bears a southern border stamp and a receipt for secret burial.
quest.desc2: The wagon-waybills run from Fort Neugrad and Helgen to Halldir's Cairn and the pyres of Sunderstone Gorge.
quest.pitch: Fresh graves in Falkreath carry names no family in the hold has ever heard.
quest.outro: In Sunderstone Gorge I burned the false burial charters and left the true name-rolls on Arkay's altar so the dead would at last be known by their own names.

arcs.title: The Maze That Lets Out
arcs.secret: The outer cairns of Hjaalmarch form a wider stone labyrinth around Bromjunaar, built not to keep intruders out of Labyrinthian, but to keep a single exiled priest from walking out.

entry.text: A quarry-stone at Stonehills is incised with a five-ring labyrinth diagram; three outer rings are chipped open from the inside.

quest.title: The Maze That Lets Out
quest.desc: A quarry-stone at Stonehills shows Hjaalmarch's ruins as concentric rings of a single maze whose inner gates have been breached from within.
quest.desc2: Following the broken ring-stones through Fort Snowhawk, Kjenstag, and Lost Valkygg leads to the maze-keeper at Labyrinthian.
quest.pitch: The ruined shrines of the marsh are all aligned to the walls of Labyrinthian.
quest.outro: At the center of the stone maze I turned the keystone back into its socket. The footsteps behind the walls stopped at the fourth ring.

arcs.title: Seven Lifts, One Missing
arcs.secret: The Dwemer great lifts of the northern mountains share a mechanical counter that tallies every cage-descent into Blackreach, and the counter shows one lift more than exists on the surface.

entry.text: Inside the cage-housing at the Great Lift at Raldbthar, a brass odometer drum clicks once whenever a distant counterweight moves—marking seven shafts where the maps show six.

quest.title: Seven Lifts, One Missing
quest.desc: A brass odometer in the Raldbthar lift-cage counts descents across seven coupled shafts, though only six surface cages are known.
quest.desc2: Tracing the counterweight cables through Mzinchaleft and Irkngthand reveals the phantom shaft's governor at the Great Lift at Alftand.
quest.pitch: Every Dwemer lift in the Pale clicks in answer to a seventh cage that no surface map records.
quest.outro: When I locked the phantom governor at Alftand, a sealed sub-shaft sighed shut far below the ice, and the six surface lifts finally kept an honest count.

arcs.title: The Honey That Does Not Spoil
arcs.secret: The prized reserve casks of the Rift never sour because the oldest apiaries are fed from a subterranean amber-fungus seam running from Honeystrand Cave under the lake to Riften.

entry.text: A wax-sealed tasting jar behind the apiary wall at Goldenglow bears a date forty winters old; the honey inside is still warm and smells faintly of cave-moss.

quest.title: The Honey That Does Not Spoil
quest.desc: A forty-year-old tasting jar at Goldenglow Estate holds honey that is still warm to the touch and scented with subterranean moss.
quest.desc2: The apiary ledgers trace the winter feed from Black-Briar Lodge and Honeystrand Cave to a hidden cellar beneath Riften.
quest.pitch: The reserve honey of the Rift never crystallises, even in midwinter frost.
quest.outro: Beneath the canal vaults I sealed the fungal amber-spring that fed the queen-hives. The next vintage will age like honest mead.

arcs.title: Salvage Rights
arcs.secret: Four ships lost along the Winterhold pack-ice were all chartered by the same factor, who moved the beacon-braziers on Snowpoint to claim the sunken cargo under coastal salvage law.

entry.text: Frozen into the quarterdeck ice of the Winter War is an oilskin pouch containing four identical salvage bonds signed before the ships ever weighed anchor.

quest.title: Salvage Rights
quest.desc: An oilskin pouch on the Wreck of the Winter War holds pre-dated salvage bonds for four different vessels along the ice coast.
quest.desc2: Comparing the rudder-chains at Hela's Folly, Pilgrim's Trench, and the Pride of Tel Vos points up the cliff to Snowpoint Beacon.
quest.pitch: Four ships went down on the same ice-reef bearing salvage bonds signed by the same hand.
quest.outro: At Snowpoint Beacon I took the factor's false chart-glass and restored the true coastal bearing. The Sea of Ghosts takes enough ships without help from the shore.

arcs.title: The Steam Under the Stones
arcs.secret: The hot-spring terraces of Eastmarch are vented exhaust from a single Dwemer geothermal manifold linking Mzulft and Kagrenzel; someone has capped the northern relief valve at Steamcrag Camp, threatening to scald the groves.

entry.text: A bronze pressure-plaque outside Mzulft's boiler vestibule lists five surface vents across the caldera basin—and the fifth needle is pinned in the red.

quest.title: The Steam Under the Stones
quest.desc: A bronze pressure-plaque at Mzulft shows five geothermal vents across the Eastmarch basin, with the fifth valve pinned shut.
quest.desc2: Following the buried bronze conduits from Kagrenzel through Eldergleam and Witchmist Grove leads to the capped relief engine at Steamcrag Camp.
quest.pitch: The geysers of Eastmarch have been boiling higher each week since a bronze valve was jammed in the caldera.
quest.outro: When I opened the relief manifold at Steamcrag Camp, a column of white steam roared into the frosty sky and the boiling pools around the Sanctuary settled back to warmth.

arcs.title: The Channels' Warden
arcs.secret: Markarth's rushing water-channels are governed by an ancient Dwemer sluice-network stretching to Bthardamz and Arkngthamz, used quietly by ore-syndicates to flood or parch rival silver shafts.

entry.text: Set into a culvert wall beneath Markarth's lower waterwheel is a brass sluice-index naming four mine-adits and their water-table depths.

quest.title: The Channels' Warden
quest.desc: A brass sluice-index beneath Markarth's waterwheel links the city's stone canals to the water-tables of four Reach mines.
quest.desc2: Tracing the flooded adits through Karthwasten, Left Hand Mine, and Bthardamz leads to the master sluice-warden in Arkngthamz.
quest.pitch: Independent silver shafts in the Reach flood overnight while syndicate mines stay bone-dry.
quest.outro: In the lower gallery of Arkngthamz I pinned the master sluice-wheel at level gauge. The Karth's water runs equal through every shaft again.

t_bone.lead: Climb the windswept ridge of Shearpoint and inspect the numbered Tsaesci saw-cut on the dragon's spine.
t_bone.clue: a dragon-mound rib-arch on Shearpoint with one cervical vertebra sawn cleanly out and tagged 'Number 27 of 41'

t_crown.lead: Examine the inner royal lintel of Korvanjund where a segment of the Hollow King's regalia was chiselled free.
t_crown.clue: a royal frieze in Korvanjund with the crown's brow-plate pried cleanly from the stone

t_dial.lead: Compare the twin bronze countdown dials in Mzulft's observatory and Alftand's glacial pump-hall.
t_dial.clue: paired Dwemer bronze dials in Mzulft and Alftand ticking in unison toward the same cross-mark

t_falls.lead: Stand on the cantilevered wooden ledge of Bard's Leap Summit and read the waterproofed stanza-cylinder wedged beneath the plank.
t_falls.clue: a waxed stanza-cylinder wedged under the waterfall ledge at Bard's Leap Summit

valtheim_towers.name: Valtheim Towers
valtheim_towers.g: Twin stone watchtowers joined by a high span above the White River rapids.
valtheim_towers.m: The bridge-pier carries the first mason's tally of the plain's ridge barrows.
c: a mason's tally-table cut into the bridge-pier
four barrow-names with dead-counts
a blank fifth line pointing to the peak
valtheim_towers.p: A rubbing of the Valtheim barrow-tally.
valtheim_towers.lead: Copy the mason's tally from Valtheim Towers and check the stones at Hamvir's Rest.

hamvirs_rest.name: Hamvir's Rest
hamvirs_rest.g: A sunken burial yard of weathered headstones and an iron-grated crypt at the foot of the northern hills.
hamvirs_rest.m: The lintel stone records the second portion of the plain's war-dead.
c: a lintel notched with seventy-two strokes
an iron grate stamped with a mason's square
a stone pointer aimed northwest
hamvirs_rest.lead: Carry the Hamvir's Rest count west to Rannveig's Fast.

rannveigs_fast.name: Rannveig's Fast
rannveigs_fast.g: An open-air Nordic ruin cut into the western steppes with a sunken word-wall plaza and a trapdoor chute.
rannveigs_fast.m: Behind the word wall sits the third tally-plinth, listing the western fallen.
c: a frost-split plinth behind the word wall
tally notches matching the Valtheim table
a mason's arrow pointing toward Dustman's Cairn
rannveigs_fast.lead: Take the western count from Rannveig's Fast to Dustman's Cairn.

dustmans_cairn.name: Dustman's Cairn
dustmans_cairn.g: A ridge-top barrow of megalithic stone rings overlooking the central moorland.
dustmans_cairn.m: The fourth tally-slab stands in the vestibule, naming the final sum owed to Eldersblood Peak.
c: a vestibule slab with a sum of four hundred and nine
a missing cornerstone chisel
a bearing line sighted toward the southern mount
dustmans_cairn.lead: Climb Eldersblood Peak with the cornerstone chisel to complete the plain's tally.

eldersblood_peak.name: Eldersblood Peak
eldersblood_peak.g: A high, ice-crowned summit above the clouds with a dragon mound and an ancient word wall.
eldersblood_peak.m: The summit slate holds the master tally of the plain, waiting for its last notch.
c: a master tally-slate one notch short
barrow-braziers aligned down the ridge
a tally-warden's frost-covered helm
eldersblood_peak.p: The completed Master Tally of the Plain.
eldersblood_peak.lead: Cut the final notch on Eldersblood Peak and face the Tally-Warden.

solitude_lighthouse.name: Solitude Lighthouse
solitude_lighthouse.g: A stone headland beacon guiding vessels out of the Sea of Ghosts into the Karth estuary.
solitude_lighthouse.m: A shutter-gauge under the oil-casks records timed blackouts used to lure ships onto the rocks.
c: a brass shutter-gauge with four bearings
blackout hours pencilled on the lamp-housing
an underwriter's seal
solitude_lighthouse.lead: Match the shutter-gauge bearings to the anchorage of the Katariah.

the_katariah.name: The Katariah
the_katariah.g: A grand vessel anchored in the sheltered shadow of the Solitude arch.
the_katariah.m: The harbor-master's log aboard records duplicate insurance policies issued on three wrecked coasters.
c: duplicate insurance manifests in the chart-drawer
a clerk's initial stamped in red wax
a bearing line toward Orphan's Tear
the_katariah.lead: Follow the insured vessel list northwest to the Wreck of the Orphan's Tear.

orphans_tear.name: Orphan's Tear
orphans_tear.g: A broken hull wedged among coastal ice-floes with salvage crates scattered across the shingle.
orphans_tear.m: The ship's bell was filed clean of its name before the wreckers ever arrived.
c: a ship's bell with its name filed off
lantern-hooks hung on the wrong side of the reef
boat-tracks leading to Brinewater Grotto
orphans_tear.p: The filed brass clapper from the Orphan's Tear.
orphans_tear.lead: Trace the salvage skiff tracks into Brinewater Grotto.

brinewater_grotto.name: Brinewater Grotto
brinewater_grotto.g: A tidal sea-cave beneath the Haafingar cliffs where smugglers unload cargo at high water.
brinewater_grotto.m: The grotto serves as the sorting depot where insured cargo is re-crated for resale.
c: fresh crates stencilled over old ship-marks
a tide-table keyed to Broken Oar Grotto
a quartermaster's tally-key
brinewater_grotto.lead: Carry the tally-key to the main anchorage in Broken Oar Grotto.

broken_oar_grotto.name: Broken Oar Grotto
broken_oar_grotto.g: A vast cavern harbor on the northern coast hiding a moored privateer brig inside the rock.
broken_oar_grotto.m: The quartermaster's chest holds the master Wreck-Light Ledger linking the false beacons to the Solitude counting-house.
c: the master Wreck-Light Ledger
shutter-lamps matching the lighthouse gauge
chests of double-insured silver
broken_oar_grotto.lead: Confront Quartermaster Vane in Broken Oar Grotto and seize the ledger.

falkreath.name: Falkreath
falkreath.g: A timbered pine-valley seat built around the largest graveyard in Skyrim.
falkreath.m: Coffin-plates from southern border skirmishes are buried under false local names in the far corner of the yard.
c: a leaden coffin-plate with a southern cipher
freshly turned sod unmarked by the priests
wheel-ruts leading toward Fort Neugrad
falkreath.lead: Follow the coffin-wagon ruts east toward Fort Neugrad.

fort_neugrad.name: Fort Neugrad
fort_neugrad.g: A mountain border fortress beside a frozen tarn guarding the Pale Pass approach.
fort_neugrad.m: The gatehouse toll-book records night wagons carrying sealed pine boxes north toward Helgen.
c: a gatehouse log listing sealed pine boxes
paid receipts stamped with a cairn-mark
sledge tracks toward Helgen
fort_neugrad.lead: Trace the night-wagon route from Fort Neugrad down to Helgen.

helgen.name: Helgen
helgen.g: A fire-blackened crossroads fortress-town whose stone cellars survived the dragon's attack.
helgen.m: Beneath the ruined barracks sits the transfer vault where the coffin-plates were swapped.
c: a crate of blank iron grave-markers
a chisel-chest in the cellar
a map marking Halldir's Cairn
helgen.lead: Take the grave-tags west to Halldir's Cairn.

halldirs_cairn.name: Halldir's Cairn
halldirs_cairn.g: An ancient mossy burial mound deep in the southern pine woods.
halldirs_cairn.m: The outer vestibule hides the pay-chest and the true name-rolls of the smuggled dead.
c: parchment rolls of foreign soldiers' names
a ledger pointing to the Sunderstone pyres
candle-wax mixed with pine pitch
halldirs_cairn.p: The true burial roll of the southern dead.
halldirs_cairn.lead: Carry the true burial roll to Sunderstone Gorge.

sunderstone_gorge.name: Sunderstone Gorge
sunderstone_gorge.g: A fire-scorched canyon cavern where necromancers and warlocks tend oil-fed braziers.
sunderstone_gorge.m: The gravedigger-lord uses the unrecorded dead to raise an untraceable thrall-company in the gorge.
c: unmarked coffins stacked beside the fire-altar
a gravedigger's seal-ring
charred waybills in the brazier
sunderstone_gorge.lead: Defeat the Gravedigger-Lord in Sunderstone Gorge and restore the true names to Falkreath.

stonehills.name: Stonehills
stonehills.g: A rocky mining settlement on the edge of the Hjaalmarch salt-fens.
stonehills.m: A dressed stone pulled from the mine adit bears a five-ring labyrinth map of the hold.
c: a five-ring labyrinth diagram cut in granite
three outer rings chipped open from within
survey sights pointing to Fort Snowhawk
stonehills.lead: Follow the first ring-bearing west to Fort Snowhawk.

fort_snowhawk.name: Fort Snowhawk
fort_snowhawk.g: A weathered stone keep rising out of the western marsh reeds.
fort_snowhawk.m: The keep's foundation sits on the second ring-post of the Bromjunaar boundary maze.
c: a foundation monolith with its ward-glyph split
footprints in the marsh mud heading east
a bronze plumb-bob
fort_snowhawk.lead: Cross the marsh from Fort Snowhawk to Kjenstag Ruins.

kjenstag_ruins.name: Kjenstag Ruins
kjenstag_ruins.g: A ring of half-sunken Nordic stones in the middle of the Hjaalmarch bog.
kjenstag_ruins.m: The third ring-stone at Kjenstag was turned ninety degrees to open the southern passage.
c: a rotated ring-stone in the peat
fresh scrape-marks on the socket
a bearing line toward Lost Valkygg
kjenstag_ruins.lead: Follow the rotated stone's bearing south to Lost Valkygg.

lost_valkygg.name: Lost Valkygg
lost_valkygg.g: A deep catacomb cut into the hillside beside the mountain pass.
lost_valkygg.m: The fourth ring-gate inside Lost Valkygg holds the keystone removed from the maze's center.
c: an iron ring-gate wedged open
a keystone carved with a spiral
a passage leading into Labyrinthian
lost_valkygg.lead: Carry the keystone into the heart of Labyrinthian.

labyrinthian.name: Labyrinthian
labyrinthian.g: A vast ruined city of the Dragon Priests crowning the mountain pass between Whiterun and Hjaalmarch.
labyrinthian.m: The central stone maze was built to keep its own keeper inside; re-seating the keystone locks the five rings.
c: an empty keystone socket at the maze center
frost-worn walls humming a low chord
five concentric ward-marks
labyrinthian.lead: Set the keystone in Labyrinthian's maze and defeat the Maze-Keeper.

great_lift_at_raldbthar.name: Great Lift at Raldbthar
great_lift_at_raldbthar.g: A brass-and-stone Dwemer surface cage descending straight into the deep earth.
great_lift_at_raldbthar.m: Its mechanical odometer counts seven coupled lift-cages across the northern mountains.
c: a seven-drum brass odometer
a counterweight cable vibrating in the shaft
a maintenance plate naming Mzinchaleft
great_lift_at_raldbthar.lead: Take the odometer plate west to the Great Lift at Mzinchaleft.

great_lift_at_mzinchaleft.name: Great Lift at Mzinchaleft
great_lift_at_mzinchaleft.g: A domed Dwemer lift-head standing beside the western snow-road of the Pale.
great_lift_at_mzinchaleft.m: The cable-sheave here shows an extra tension line running down into Mzinchaleft's pump-rooms.
c: a twin-grooved bronze sheave
an unmapped seventh tension cable
a calibration wrench
great_lift_at_mzinchaleft.lead: Descend into Mzinchaleft to trace the seventh tension cable.

mzinchaleft.name: Mzinchaleft
mzinchaleft.g: A sprawling Dwemer ruin in the Pale whose lower workshops open onto the Blackreach lift.
mzinchaleft.m: The workshop blueprints show a sealed seventh shaft between Irkngthand and Alftand.
c: a rolled copper blueprint of seven shafts
a governor gear with one tooth sheared
conduit markers toward Irkngthand
mzinchaleft.lead: Carry the copper blueprint east to Irkngthand.

irkngthand.name: Irkngthand
irkngthand.g: A high-walled Dwemer citadel built into the icy cliffs of the southern Pale.
irkngthand.m: The relay-room in Irkngthand routes the seventh lift's steam pressure toward Alftand.
c: a steam-relay manifold set to Shaft Seven
a brass governor key
a pressure pipe running north
irkngthand.lead: Take the governor key to the Great Lift at Alftand.

great_lift_at_alftand.name: Great Lift at Alftand
great_lift_at_alftand.g: A wind-scoured Dwemer lift-tower perched above the glacial gorge of Alftand.
great_lift_at_alftand.m: Locking the seventh governor here shuts down the phantom sub-shaft below the glacier.
c: a seventh governor socket behind the cage lever
warm steam rising from an unmapped sub-shaft
the Lift-Warden's brass chassis
great_lift_at_alftand.lead: Lock the seventh governor at the Great Lift at Alftand and defeat the Lift-Warden.

goldenglow_estate.name: Goldenglow Estate
goldenglow_estate.g: A fortified island apiary on Lake Honrich surrounded by golden birch trees and wooden hives.
goldenglow_estate.m: A forty-year-old tasting jar behind the apiary wall holds honey that never cools or crystallises.
c: a warm forty-year-old honey jar
moss spores suspended in the amber
feed-cart receipts from Black-Briar Lodge
goldenglow_estate.lead: Follow the apiary feed-receipts east to Black-Briar Lodge.

black_briar_lodge.name: Black-Briar Lodge
black_briar_lodge.g: A guarded country manor in the eastern hills overlooking the Rift valley.
black_briar_lodge.m: The cellar stores winter bee-feed mixed with glowing cave-resin from Honeystrand.
c: casks of resin-laced bee-feed
a factor's map of Honeystrand Cave
a brasshive-smoker
black_briar_lodge.lead: Trace the resin casks south to Honeystrand Cave.

honeystrand_cave.name: Honeystrand Cave
honeystrand_cave.g: A mossy limestone cavern south of Ivarstead where wild bees nest in the warm rock.
honeystrand_cave.m: Deep in the cave, an amber-fungus seam warms the rock and preserves everything it touches.
c: combs of warm amber-fungus
wooden troughs channeling the sap toward the lake
cart-tracks toward Snow-Shod Farm
honeystrand_cave.p: A cutting of the amber-fungus comb.
honeystrand_cave.lead: Follow the sap-trough trail to Snow-Shod Farm.

snow_shod_farm.name: Snow-Shod Farm
snow_shod_farm.g: A prosperous farmstead outside Riften's walls with root cellars near the lake shore.
snow_shod_farm.m: A drainage grate in the root cellar connects the amber seam to the lower canal vaults of Riften.
c: a root-cellar grate warm to the touch
amber droplets on the brickwork
a key to the lower canal sluice
snow_shod_farm.lead: Enter Riften's lower canal vault with the sluice-key.

riften.name: Riften
riften.g: A two-tiered timber city spanning the eastern end of Lake Honrich above stone canal vaults.
riften.m: In the deepest canal vault sits the queen-hive fed by the amber spring.
c: a subterranean queen-hive glowing gold
reserve casks stamped forty winters back
the Amber-Hive Matron's nest
riften.lead: Seal the amber spring beneath Riften and defeat the Amber-Hive Matron.

wreck_of_the_winter_war.name: Wreck of the Winter War
wreck_of_the_winter_war.g: A merchant hull crushed between pack-ice floes northeast of Windhelm and Winterhold.
wreck_of_the_winter_war.m: An oilskin pouch on the quarterdeck holds pre-dated salvage bonds for four coastal ships.
c: four pre-dated salvage bonds
a sawed rudder-chain
a bearing toward Hela's Folly
wreck_of_the_winter_war.lead: Carry the salvage bond west along the ice to Hela's Folly.

helas_folly.name: Hela's Folly
helas_folly.g: A listing shipwreck pinned against a rocky island off the northern glacier.
helas_folly.m: The ship's compass-box was weighted with iron filings to pull her four points south onto the reef.
c: a compass-box packed with iron filings
a salvage factor's brass tag
a diver's line toward Pilgrim's Trench
helas_folly.lead: Follow the salvage buoys to Pilgrim's Trench.

pilgrims_trench.name: Pilgrim's Trench
pilgrims_trench.g: A deep, freezing abyssal cleft in the coastal shelf littered with sunken hulls.
pilgrims_trench.m: A salvage diving-bell on the ice-shelf holds crates lifted from three wrecks before their losses were posted.
c: manifests dated three days before the storm
a factor's grappling hook
sled-ruts heading to the Pride of Tel Vos
pilgrims_trench.lead: Follow the sled-ruts east to the Wreck of the Pride of Tel Vos.

wreck_of_the_pride_of_tel_vos.name: Wreck of the Pride of Tel Vos
wreck_of_the_pride_of_tel_vos.g: A Dunmer coaster split across an ice-shelf east of Winterhold.
wreck_of_the_pride_of_tel_vos.m: The lookout's log records a movable lantern on the cliff below Snowpoint Beacon.
c: a lookout's sketch of a moving cliff-light
sled-chains leading up the headland
a signal-mirror
wreck_of_the_pride_of_tel_vos.lead: Climb the headland to Snowpoint Beacon.

snowpoint_beacon.name: Snowpoint Beacon
snowpoint_beacon.g: A stone watch-tower crowning the wind-blasted headland above the Sea of Ghosts.
snowpoint_beacon.m: Captain Varek uses a wheeled brazier on the cliff-edge to draw chartered ships onto the shoals.
c: a wheeled false-brazier on iron rails
the master salvage-claim register
crates of unclaimed ship-stores
snowpoint_beacon.lead: Defeat Captain Varek at Snowpoint Beacon and restore the true coast light.

mzulft.name: Mzulft
mzulft.g: A Dwemer steam-observatory built into the eastern mountains above the volcanic tundra.
mzulft.m: A bronze manifold plaque outside the boiler hall shows five basin vents and a pinned fifth gauge.
c: a five-vent pressure plaque with needle five in the red
a bronze valve-key
conduit markers toward Kagrenzel
mzulft.lead: Follow the high mountain conduit from Mzulft to Kagrenzel.

kagrenzel.name: Kagrenzel
kagrenzel.g: A high Dwemer resonant chamber in the Velothi crags above an underground river plunge.
kagrenzel.m: The acoustic orb-cage in Kagrenzel regulates the water-feed into the Eastmarch steam pipes.
c: a flooded intake grate
a pressure-log stamped in Dwemer numerals
warm water spilling toward Eldergleam
kagrenzel.lead: Follow the warm subterranean stream down to Eldergleam Sanctuary.

eldergleam_sanctuary.name: Eldergleam Sanctuary
eldergleam_sanctuary.g: A sunlit cavern grove where an ancient tree spreads its roots across warm mineral springs.
eldergleam_sanctuary.m: The scalding back-pressure from the capped northern valve is blistering the lower roots of the grove.
c: blistered root-bark over a buried bronze pipe
a pilgrim's warning slate
steam-vents hissing toward Witchmist Grove
eldergleam_sanctuary.p: A relief-valve coupling from beneath the roots.
eldergleam_sanctuary.lead: Carry the valve coupling east to Witchmist Grove.

witchmist_grove.name: Witchmist Grove
witchmist_grove.g: A fog-shrouded copse hovering over bubbling sulfur pools in the center of the caldera.
witchmist_grove.m: An exposed Dwemer junction-box in the bog has been wedged shut with iron spikes.
c: iron spikes driven into a bronze junction-box
scalding mud-pots
heavy boot-tracks toward Steamcrag Camp
witchmist_grove.lead: Follow the tracks across the flats to Steamcrag Camp.

steamcrag_camp.name: Steamcrag Camp
steamcrag_camp.g: A geothermal basin camp ringed by roaring steam-vents and ancient stone piers.
steamcrag_camp.m: The fifth relief-engine stands capped under the central crag, guarded by a woken centurion.
c: a capped Dwemer relief-tower
pressure needles trembling at the limit
the Vent-Engine Overseer
steamcrag_camp.lead: Open the relief manifold at Steamcrag Camp and defeat the Vent-Engine Overseer.

markarth.name: Markarth
markarth.g: A vertical city of Dwemer stone and rushing waterfalls wedged into the Karth gorge.
markarth.m: Beneath the lower waterwheel sits a brass sluice-index that rations water-table pressure across four mines.
c: a brass sluice-index naming four mines
fresh grease on the diversion lever
a conduit map toward Karthwasten
markarth.lead: Carry the sluice-index up the river road to Karthwasten.

karthwasten.name: Karthwasten
karthwasten.g: An independent silver-mining village perched on the northern crags of the Reach.
karthwasten.m: The lower silver drift flooded the same night the syndicate's sluice-lever was turned in Markarth.
c: a flooded lower drift with Dwemer pipe-grates
a miner's depth-line
a dry tunnel pointing to Left Hand Mine
karthwasten.lead: Compare the water-gauge with the dry shafts at Left Hand Mine.

left_hand_mine.name: Left Hand Mine
left_hand_mine.g: An iron-and-silver mining hamlet just outside Markarth's main gate.
left_hand_mine.m: A hidden bronze bypass valve in the back gallery drains Left Hand's water into the Bthardamz aqueduct.
c: a bronze bypass valve behind the timber props
a syndicate foreman's key
an aqueduct heading north to Bthardamz
left_hand_mine.lead: Follow the Dwemer aqueduct north to Bthardamz.

bthardamz.name: Bthardamz
bthardamz.g: A vast, terraced Dwemer city in the northern Reach with deep cisterns and bronze viaducts.
bthardamz.m: The cistern regulator in Bthardamz is slaved to the master sluice-hall in Arkngthamz.
c: a cistern regulator locked in diversion mode
a brass master-spindle
a high-pressure conduit running south to Arkngthamz
bthardamz.lead: Carry the master-spindle south to Arkngthamz.

arkngthamz.name: Arkngthamz
arkngthamz.g: A cavern-spanning Dwemer ruin in the southern Reach built around tonal chimes and subterranean rivers.
arkngthamz.m: The master sluice-wheel in the lower river gallery governs the water-table of the entire Reach.
c: the master sluice-wheel of the Karth
five tonal water-gauges
the Sluice-Warden's pedestal
arkngthamz.p: The Master Sluice-Pin of the Reach.
arkngthamz.lead: Pin the master sluice-wheel in Arkngthamz and defeat the Sluice-Warden.

shearpoint.name: Shearpoint
shearpoint.g: An icy mountain crest in the Pale crowned by a dragon burial mound and a three-word wall.
shearpoint.m: One cervical vertebra has been sawn cleanly from the dragon mound's rib-arch and tagged for the Bone Census.
c: a clean saw-cut in the dragon mound's spine
a silk tag reading 'Number 27 of 41'
monks' boot-prints in the rime
shearpoint.lead: Inspect the tagged vertebra-gap on Shearpoint.

korvanjund.name: Korvanjund
korvanjund.g: A grand, half-buried Nordic temple in the southern Pale where the Jagged Crown was entombed.
korvanjund.m: Behind the inner throne, a section of the older Hollow King's frieze has been chiselled away.
c: a royal frieze with its brow-plate chiselled out
a pilgrim's wax seal
chisel-marks matching the Sundered Crown thefts
korvanjund.lead: Examine the chiselled royal frieze in the inner crypt of Korvanjund.

alftand.name: Alftand
alftand.g: A Dwemer ruin sunk into a glacial fissure in Winterhold, descending into Blackreach.
alftand.m: Deep in the pump-hall sits a bronze countdown dial ticking in unison with the dial in Mzulft.
c: a frost-rimmed bronze dial with one moving hand
a scholar's cross-mark one tick ahead
conduit lines to Mzulft
alftand.lead: Read the synchronized bronze dial in Alftand's glacial pump-hall.

bards_leap_summit.name: Bard's Leap Summit
bards_leap_summit.g: A dizzying waterfall precipice in the Reach where a wooden plank juts over a deep canyon pool.
bards_leap_summit.m: Wedged beneath the leaping plank is a waxed stanza-cylinder from the continental Falls thread.
c: a waxed brass cylinder under the waterfall plank
four verses of the Falling Water song
a minstrel's carved plectrum
bards_leap_summit.lead: Recover the waxed stanza-cylinder from the ledge at Bard's Leap Summit.
